title: Rush Hour Dish Rescue
premise: A cute arcade kitchen-cleaning game where the player swipes a bubbly scrub buddy over dirty dishes before they spoil during a frantic service rush.
interaction_model: Real-time pointer or touch swiping on a full-screen canvas; movement controls a trailing scrub character that only cleans while actively scrubbing over the dish.
objective: Save as many dishes as possible by fully cleaning each one before its freshness timer runs out, while building a streak during a single endless run.
progression: Immediate endless arcade loop with one active dish at a time, escalating tension through repeated short timers, streak tracking, warning cues, and sudden-death failure when any dish expires.
theme: Playful restaurant rush mixed with bubbly dishwashing and neon arcade presentation.
mood: Cheerful, hectic, polished, and slightly tense under time pressure.
likely_audience: Casual mobile and web players who enjoy quick reflex games, cleaning-themed interactions, and snack-sized arcade loops.
confidence_notes: High confidence that this is a swipe-based arcade cleaning game centered on saving dishes before timeout.
Moderate confidence on genre labeling: it overlaps cleaning, cooking, and reflex arcade microgame categories rather than fitting a deep simulator.
High confidence that the run structure is endless until a single failure triggers game over.
recreation_prompt: Create a polished mobile-friendly arcade cleaning game called "Rush Hour Dish Rescue" where the player controls a cute bubble scrub buddy by swiping or dragging across the screen on a full-screen canvas. Present one dirty food dish at a time on a restaurant counter, using playful illustrated items like burgers, hot dogs, chicken, sushi, and pizza. The scrub buddy should smoothly follow the player input and only clean the active dish when the player is moving fast enough to count as scrubbing while overlapping it. Each dish needs a visible cleanliness requirement and a short countdown freshness bar; if the player scrubs enough before time expires, the dish is saved, the score and streak increase, a cheerful success effect plays, and a new dirty dish appears. If any dish timer reaches zero, immediately end the run with a dramatic but cute game-over overlay showing dishes saved and a restart button. Use bright neon-kitchen colors, bubbly particle effects, HUD cards for score and streak, warning cues when time gets low, celebratory and fail reactions, and energetic arcade audio. Keep the loop simple, fast, and replayable: swipe fast, clean the dish, chain saves, and survive as long as possible in a single-session reflex challenge.
